_doc: Overrides for tools/terrain/make_cleanground.py (clean ground under the 3D view's ground objects).
keep: models (name prefixes) whose painting stays: landscape the game animates or builds from enemies
(TORM's, BONUS' and ROOST's waterfalls, FRUIT's glyph trees, the rock arches standing on painted rock),
and what the map paints as landscape (FRUIT's geodesic balls leave a hole into space; the gun silos of
SAVARA, SAVARA IV, REEF and DIG SITE are pits in the fortress walls).
standin: a piece's look -> the look whose model stands in for the painting once the piece is gone
(sheet letter and first sprite, as models.cfg names them; x<hex> for a symbol). Dead looks (dgr with
dlevel -1, which the game itself leaves standing) are taken without a line here; damaged looks only
where they are the painted picture. Pieces with neither get a placeholder: their own model, slumped
and darkened, until stage 4 gives them a wreck model of their own (a line here then).
keep_maps: as keep, for one map (hash): where a look's painting is landscape there only (BOTANY B's cliff
bunkers stand on rock in the water, MINERS' red spires and mounds are its rock).
skip_maps: maps (hashes) the tool leaves alone (their .era and .std stay as they are), and why.
no_palms: maps (hashes) whose painted palms stay painted.
upper_maps: background 3's maps (hashes) cleaned too, where the top enemies riding them stand (the ground log's riding: lines; no copies of their tiles elsewhere), and their levels.
